title: draining soap dish
text: draining soap dish. I like the glycerin type soaps.. and you MUST have a draining soap dish... these are reasonably priced and do the trick.  You do get 2.  I got the pink edge.. it's a "soft" pink in my opinion.. not "hot pink."  They are plastic, but I think they will last for as long as they need to.  I will update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Topsky Soap Dish for Shower, 2pcs Soap Dishes Soap Savers for Bar Soap, Soap Bar Holder Shower with Drip Tray, Plastic Soap Holders with Drain for Kitchen Sink, Easy to Clean, Keeps The Soap Dry
features: 【Drains well】Two pieces design, a catch basin(Drainage dish allows enough room to catch excess water) and a top level with open slots that drain. Slats in the top layer are wide enough for water/soap slime can fall through a grate into the bottom. Excess water ends up in the soap bar holder, not on our sink or counter. so the soap drys quickly which saves on soap.

【Easy to clean】Its a handy soap dish that comes apart so you can just separate the two part and rinses off fully with a quick rinse under the faucet and we don’t have to dry it to put the soap back. They can also easily ride on the top rack of the dishwasher for regular cleaning.

【Sturdy & light】These soap dish tray are a polycarbonate material, sturdy, don't rust, light and very quet. They are lightweight, won’t break like a ceramic one if dropped and also won’t chip tiles. so don't have to worry about kids knocking it off counter and breaking it. Suitable for daily uses.
【Compact size】Soap case size is 5.1" x 3.7" x 1.1". They are pretty compact and doesn't take up much room on counter and fit easily on the sink. They are awesome for using in a camper or RV.

【Multi-purpose】This soap saver is a two pack, we can have one at the kitchen sink and one at the bathroom sink or on the shelf in the shower. Besides a soap holder I use it to hold a nail scrub brush, face soap, dishes cleaning brushes,bar shampoo and conditioner etc. Perfect for the bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, etc.
Feature: Easy to Clean, Durable and sturdy
